extractedBy: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5), agent pack POC session
notes: Guide and evidence were checked against jfs-components 0.1.60 (21 September 2026). The guide gives no accessibility guidance of its own; the evidence records two web gaps. The registration summary does not name the component.

useWhen.text: Reveal supporting details when people need them, while keeping the page easy to scan.

from.quote: Reveal supporting details when people need them, while keeping the page easy to scan.

avoidWhen.text: Hiding the page's main task: leave it in the page flow when hiding it would block progress or change the decision.

from.quote: Leave the main task in the page flow when hiding it would block progress or change the decision.

anatomy.holds: The title: the promise people use to decide whether to open the section.

from.quote: The title is the promise people use to decide whether to open the section.

anatomy.holds: The header text, short enough to stay scannable in a narrow host.

from.quote: Keep the header short enough to remain scannable in a narrow host.

anatomy.holds: Add and minus icons the component switches as it opens and closes.

from.quote: The public component switches between add and minus icons as it opens and closes.

anatomy.holds: The bottom border that separates the open section from the following content.

from.quote: The component’s bottom border separates the open section from the following content.

anatomy.holds: children: supporting details or related public rows.

from.quote: Put supporting details or related public rows here; keep primary actions visible in the page flow.

placementAdvice.text: Keep the primary action outside the Accordion, in the page flow; use the Accordion for supporting details.

from.quote: Use the Accordion for supporting details while the main payment action stays in the page flow.

placementAdvice.text: Do not put the primary action in the content slot: it is unavailable until someone expands the section.

from.quote: The button is unavailable until someone expands the section, so the task is harder to complete.

placementAdvice.text: Several Accordions can sit together; each keeps its own expanded state, and the screen's wiring decides whether one, both or neither is open.

from.quote: Two public Accordions can sit together while each keeps its own expanded state. Consumer wiring decides whether one, both, or neither is open.

placementAdvice.text: Let the host supply the width; the Accordion grows with its title and open content.

from.quote: In a product layout, the host supplies width and the component grows with its title and open content.

configuration.text: Use the default treatment (contained false) when the heading can sit comfortably in the surrounding page structure.

from.quote: Use the default when the heading can sit comfortably in the surrounding page structure.

configuration.text: Use contained when the filled header should keep related supporting content together, so the group stands apart from its host.

from.quote: Use contained when the filled header should keep related supporting content together.

configuration.text: Set expanded (or defaultExpanded) and disabled to reflect the product situation, and let the header show the result.

from.quote: Choose the expanded or disabled condition that reflects the product situation and let the header communicate the result.

configuration.text: Leave the Accordion States mode unset: the component derives it from expanded, disabled, hover and contained.
To let a long title wrap instead of truncating, set disableTruncation.

rules.text: Make the header a clear promise about the content inside.

from.quote: Make the header a clear promise about the content inside.

rules.text: The header should tell people what they will find; the body answers the question the header raises.

from.quote: Use a meaningful header and let the body answer the question that header raises.

rules.text: Keep the header short enough to stay scannable in a narrow host.

from.quote: Keep the header short enough to remain scannable in a narrow host.

rules.text: Allow a long title to wrap when the group name needs more than one line.

from.quote: Allow a long title to wrap when the group name needs more than one line.

rules.text: Put rows or short explanatory text in the content slot when they answer the header's promise.

from.quote: Rows or short explanatory text belong in the content slot when they answer the header’s promise.

rules.text: Do not mix unrelated information in one section: the heading stops helping.

from.quote: The heading stops helping because the open content answers several different questions.

bad: Support hours, marketing preferences, and unrelated profile reminders.

states.when: The default (defaultExpanded false): the heading shows and the content stays out of the initial scan.

from.quote: The heading is visible while supporting content stays out of the initial scan.

states.when: expanded (or defaultExpanded) is true, after the person asks for more detail.

from.quote: The content slot is visible after the person asks for more detail.

states.when: disabled is true: the section is unavailable until the product condition changes.

from.quote: The section is unavailable until the product condition changes.

states.when: Supplied by the component under a pointer; not configured.

from.quote: Expanded, disabled, and hover feedback come from the public component as people interact.

doDont.dont: Use a heading with no meaning
doDont.why: People must open the section before they know whether it contains the detail they need.

from.quote: Name what people will find

doDont.why: The heading stops helping because the open content answers several different questions.

from.quote: Keep the content related

doDont.dont: Hide the primary action in the body
doDont.why: The button is unavailable until someone expands the section, so the task is harder to complete.

from.quote: Keep primary work visible

examples.purpose: A section whose body answers its header, with Text in the content slot.
examples.jsx:
<Accordion title="Payment methods" modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>
  <Text text="Review the payment methods available for this account." modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }} />
</Accordion>

from.quote: Use a meaningful header and let the body answer the question that header raises.

examples.purpose: A contained, controlled section holding related rows.
examples.jsx:
<Accordion title="Bank accounts" contained expanded onExpandedChange={(expanded) => {}} modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>
  <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="Savings Account" supportText="HDFC Bank" modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }} />
</Accordion>

from.quote: Use contained when the filled header should keep related supporting content together.

examples.purpose: Supporting details in an Accordion, with the primary action outside it in the page flow.
examples.jsx:
<VStack modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>
  <Accordion title="Payment details" modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>
    <Text text="Paid from your JioFinance account." modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }} />
  </Accordion>
  <Button label="Confirm payment" onPress={() => {}} modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light', Emphasis: 'High', AppearanceBrand: 'Primary' }} />
</VStack>

from.quote: Use the Accordion for supporting details while the main payment action stays in the page flow.

evidenceFacts.name: showHeader
evidenceFacts.description: Developer-only: part of a sticky-header split, not a designer setting.

evidenceFacts.name: showContent
evidenceFacts.description: Developer-only: part of a sticky-header split, not a designer setting.

gaps.text: Dark mode does not restyle the Accordion: its title, icon and header background resolve to the same values in Light and Dark, so the text stays black on a dark host.
gaps.quote: the dark preview retaining black Accordion text on a dark host is a demonstrated package token/resolver limitation

gaps.text: On the web the header does not expose aria-expanded, although Enter and Space toggle it.
gaps.quote: the rendered button does not expose an `aria-expanded` attribute even though Enter and Space toggle it correctly

gaps.text: In the React Native Web preview, opening and closing is immediate, with no transition.
gaps.quote: In the local React Native Web preview, this transition is immediate
